-- Phase 1 spec: config_value returns the value for `key` in
-- a `name=value` per-line config text, or "" when the key is absent.
-- Pure function: it reads no files and declares no capability.

config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str =
  pre key.char_count() > 0
  post out.char_count() <= text.char_count()
  ex config_value("a=1\nb=2", "b") == "2"
  ex config_value("a=1", "z") == ""
  for line in text.split("\n")
    let parts = line.split("=")
    if parts.len() >= 2 and parts[0] == key
      var v = parts[1].copy()
      for i in range(2, parts.len())
        v = "\(v)=\(parts[i])"
      return v
  ""
